dish.note: Strong black tea with condensed milk, poured into tin mugs.
dish.how: Boil 1.2 litres of water, pour over 6 black tea bags in a large pot and steep for 5 minutes. Stir 4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk through the pot until dissolved and serve in tin mugs or sturdy enamel mugs.

steps.text: Boil the water and pour it over the tea bags in a large pot.
Steep for 5 minutes and stir in the condensed milk until dissolved.
